## Project Map Impact Check

- [ ] I read the relevant `.project-map` module/flow before changing behavior.
- [ ] I updated the relevant module, flow, state, integration note or ADR when
  this change altered its semantic reality; or this is a pure internal change
  with no Map update needed.
- [ ] I ran `node scripts/project-map/project-map.mjs impact` and acted on its
  relevant review prompts.
- [ ] I ran `node scripts/project-map/project-map.mjs generate` when indexed
  source, route, migration, endpoint, test or mapped path changed.
- [ ] I ran `node scripts/project-map/project-map.mjs check`.
